`Content-Type: application/json` | | **Body** | `{"type":"vote","attributes":{"verdict":"malicious"}}` | ### Example using `curl` ```bash curl -X POST \ https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/vote \ -H "x-apikey: YOUR_KEY_FOUR" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"type":"vote","attributes":{"verdict":"malicious"}}' ``` ### Example using Python (`requests`) ```python import requests url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/vote" headers = { "x-apikey": "YOUR_KEY_FOUR", "Content-Type": "application/json" } payload = { "type": "vote", "attributes": { "verdict": "malicious" } } response = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers) print(response.status_code) print(response.json()) ``` Replace `YOUR_KEY_FOUR` with the actual API key value you have for “key_four”.
